profile.headline: Associate Software Engineer at T. Rowe Price | MBA - Information Systems
profile.summary:
I'm a seasoned Software Engineer and Data Analyst with a strong passion for data analytics, project management, and a proven track record of delivering results. My expertise encompasses a range of areas, including constructing and managing data systems, extracting insights from complex data, and effectively leading Agile teams as a Certified Scrum Master.

My educational background includes a Master of Business Administration (MBA), providing me with a well-rounded skill set that combines technical proficiency with a deep understanding of business strategies.

I've had the opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional teams in the design and maintenance of unified data systems using Snowflake. I've also successfully managed independent projects, overseeing them from concept to implementation, ensuring on-time delivery and high-quality results.

I've developed and implemented efficient ETL processes for large datasets and created predictive models to enhance decision-making processes.

In addition to my analytical skills, I'm well-versed in data visualization tools such as Tableau, Qlik, and Power BI, enabling me to craft insightful visualizations and dashboards that provide actionable insights to stakeholders.

I'm also proficient in various programming and scripting languages, database technologies, and project management tools. My goal is to leverage this expertise to drive innovation and excellence in data analysis, software engineering, and project management.

Let's connect and explore opportunities to collaborate or share insights in the fields of data analysis, software engineering, and project management.

positions.title: Global Investment Operations Intern
positions.description:
• Facilitate brainstorming sessions and idea generation sessions for the creation of collaboration sites and process workflows among the global Investment Liaisons  
• Analyze and report significant portfolio cash flows to ensure firm is following Global Investment Performance Standards
• Accurately record and report changes in composite accounts including creations, assignments, exclusions and terminations
• Utilize data visualization tools and programming languages, including VBA, to increase automation, improve efficiency, and reduce risk.
